mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item_review ( item_id, member_id, item_review_content, item_star, reg_time ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, #{star}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT r.item_review_id AS reviewId, r.item_review_content AS content, r.item_star AS star, m.id AS createdBy, DATE_FORMAT(r.reg_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS regTime FROM item_review r JOIN member m ON r.member_id = m.member_id WHERE r.item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY r.item_review_id DESC
